decisions: Object-level CreateFile share pins exclude DELETE (and WRITE on files); ancestor pinning and atomic/storage protocol stay with the caller.

Privacy is the conservative allowlist (token user, SYSTEM, Administrators), present protected DACL, no deny/unknown/foreign ACEs; inherited children are a separate opt-in via a live private_root handle.

CREATE_NEW / CreateDirectoryW take an explicit in-process SDDL then verify the actual descriptor before any content write; existing ACLs are never rewritten and failed directory verify does not delete.

Win32Native talks only the injectable binding protocol; CtypesBindings loads kernel32/advapi32 solely on Windows or when both fake DLLs are supplied, with portable DWORD/BOOL/WORD/BYTE and packed identity structs.
adopted: Reject newly created non-directory handle if metadata reports nonzero initial size; preserve bytes and close handle before returning fixed conflict.
Validate all identity metadata numbers fit their actual DWORD or 64-bit Windows field widths.

notAdopted.reason: CreateFileW flags omit FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT; opening a symlink can follow its target before reparse metadata is checked.
First snapshot initializes canonical path from actual handle rather than binding it to caller-requested path.
Failure cleanup catches close failure but still marks the handle closed, losing truthful ownership/release state.
Drive-root paths are refused; the root protocol needs to pin drive-root ancestors.
Descriptor/token cleanup ignores native failures; final code checks resource release and keeps fixed errors.

notInDispatchedProposal: FileRenameInfo relative leaf and RootDirectory handle binding
scopeLimits: No native Windows execution or platform admission.
Handle deletion may remain pending while other compatible handles survive.
Source/parent sharing, NTFS data/metadata behavior and installed Windows11 evidence remain unverified.
proposalLimits: NTFS + FILE_PERSISTENT_ACLS + DRIVE_FIXED only; reparse/device attributes, UNC/device/ADS/relative paths, impersonation, and non-disk handles are refused.
Synchronous IO is capped at 128KiB; write is first-shot into a newly created zero-size file; flush is not durability, rename atomicity, or crash safety.
This module is not wired into the helper and does not implement rename, replace, hardlink, publication, delete, registry, or ACL repair.
NativeError never surfaces OS text, paths, SIDs, or native codes; import on non-Windows does not load DLLs.
